entities.name: Query protein QueC
observations: 226 aa protein; calculated molecular weight 25.53 kDa, theoretical pI 5.20, and estimated charge at pH 7 of -7.19.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q2NF51 from Methanosphaera stadtmanae; alignment identity and coverage are both 100%.
Belongs to the QueC family; Pfam QueC (PF06508.20) spans residues 4–216 with i-Evalue 2.2e-65.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine to 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine (preQ0), EC 6.3.4.20.
Curated homolog annotations indicate one Zn2+ ion bound per subunit and ATP-dependent carbon-nitrogen bond-forming ligase activity.
Associated with 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine biosynthesis in purine metabolism and GO terms ATP binding, zinc ion binding, and carbon-nitrogen ligase activity.
Sequence contains a cysteine-rich C-terminal region consistent with the conserved zinc-binding site reported at homologous positions 192, 200, 203, and 206.
No transmembrane segment or obvious signal peptide is apparent from the sequence; intracellular localization is therefore the parsimonious inference, not a directly curated localization result.
